title: TTWorkspaceVfsViewContract
description: Contract schema for C-ABI / UniFFI TTWorkspaceVfsView memory mapping descriptor

node_count.description: Total number of 64-byte CSR entry nodes

string_arena_size.description: Total byte size of the contiguous string arena

root_node_id.description: Index of the root node (0 for synthetic root)

node_size_bytes.description: Exact byte size of each entry node (must be 64)

page_aligned_total_bytes.description: Total memory size rounded up to 16KB page boundary
